name: Merajot
title: Priest in Aaron's lineage
summary: Merajot was a priest in the Levitical line, a descendant of Aaron through Eleazar. He is mentioned in the priestly genealogies in 1 Chronicles and Ezra as an important link in the high priests' genealogy. His role in the lineage connects the early priesthood to the priests who served in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the priests' genealogy in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Merajot is listed in the priestly line from Aaron through Eleazar, documenting the unbroken priestly line.

keyEvents.title: The genealogy repeated in 1 Chronicles 6
keyEvents.description: Merajot is mentioned again in the extended priestly genealogy, confirming his place among the high priests.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ezra's genealogy
keyEvents.description: In the book of Ezra, Ezra's priestly lineage is traced back through Merajot, which legitimizes Ezra's priestly authority.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Zadokite line
keyEvents.description: Through his son Amariah, Merajot is a key link in the lineage leading to the high priests Zadok and later Ezra.

keyEvents.title: Part of the second Merajot line in Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: A Merajot is also mentioned in the book of Nehemiah in connection with the genealogical records of the priests and Levites after the return from exile.
